answer: Ledge-tide mooring bond stops bulk fake identities: each identity locks 70 and moors a key-bound skiff at the jetty. Each epoch it must wander to a fresh post and file a signed tide reading. The auditor replays readings at the ledge board; a missing or reused reading burns the bond. A rented-mooring ring fails: readings carry their own key. 1,000 fakes pay 35,000, lock 70,000, chase at most 40,000. An honest agent pays 35 once, recovers 70.
